evidence.proposition: NVIDIA HGX documentation specifies H200, B200 and B300 accelerators with HBM3e memory, including 141GB, 180GB and 288GB per GPU respectively.
Micron stated that its calendar-2025 HBM output was sold out and that it was seeing strong demand for 2026 HBM supply.
evidence.semantic_limit: SUPPLIER_SPECIFIC; DOES_NOT_PROVE ENTIRE INDUSTRY SUPPLY IS SOLD OUT

evidence.proposition: Micron stated that HBM3E 12-high had begun volume production and that it was focused on ramping capacity and yield.
evidence.semantic_limit: YIELD VALUE NOT DISCLOSED; RAMP DOES NOT EQUAL FULL EFFECTIVE CAPACITY

evidence.proposition: Micron stated that HBM3E 8-high was designed into NVIDIA GB200 and HBM3E 12-high was designed into GB300, while additional platform/customer qualifications were progressing.
evidence.semantic_limit: DESIGN-IN DOES NOT BY ITSELF PROVE ALL CUSTOMER QUALIFICATION OR SHIPMENT VOLUME

evidence.proposition: SK hynix stated in February 2024 that its planned HBM production volume for 2024 had already sold out.
evidence.semantic_limit: SUPPLIER_SPECIFIC; PLANNED PRODUCTION SOLD OUT DOES NOT QUANTIFY EFFECTIVE OUTPUT

evidence.proposition: SK hynix announced volume production of HBM3E and planned customer supply from late March 2024.
evidence.semantic_limit: VOLUME PRODUCTION DOES NOT PROVE UNRESERVED AVAILABLE CAPACITY

evidence.proposition: TSMC stated that robust AI-related demand continued in 2025 and reaffirmed that revenue from AI accelerators was expected to double in 2025.
evidence.semantic_limit: DEMAND SIGNAL DOES NOT BY ITSELF PROVE A CONSTRAINT

evidence.proposition: TSMC's CEO stated that CoWoS capacity remained fully loaded and that the company needed to double CoWoS capacity to meet demand.
evidence.semantic_limit: TSMC-SPECIFIC COWOS SCOPE; DOES NOT PROVE ALL ADVANCED PACKAGING WORLDWIDE IS CONSTRAINED

evidence.proposition: TSMC's CEO said CoWoS supply-demand was expected to be more balanced in 2026 while the company continued capacity expansion.
evidence.semantic_limit: FORWARD EXPECTATION IS NOT OBSERVED CONSTRAINT RESOLUTION

evidence.semantic_limit: TECHNOLOGY ENTERED PRODUCTION; DOES NOT QUANTIFY AVAILABLE OR UNBOOKED CAPACITY
